name: Raycasting Phase
aliases: Two-Pass Raycasting with Back-Face Depth Buffering
definition: The final raycasting time is determined by the runtime of the thread that takes the most integration steps, which depends on the view and decomposition geometry interaction.
summary: The Raycasting Phase is the computational core of image-order volume rendering that samples optical properties along camera rays and integrates them to produce pixel colors, distinguished by its two-pass geometry-based traversal using back-face depth buffering.
